gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 31.620 million in 2019. This adverse development was primarily driven by claims deterioration in exited lines of business, specifically impacting Excess Casualty, Direct & Facultative Property, other non-core Property lines, Healthcare, and Construction. Net adverse movements of GBP 18.5 million were observed across several lines, with significant strengthening in Third Party Liability, Marine, and Accident & Health, partially offset by releases in Property and Reinsurance. Gross written premiums for the year totaled GBP 175.405 million, with Reinsurance being the largest segment.
